detail: Decisions: Reverted single-call git rev-parse optimization — --abbrev-ref is global so the two-positional-arg form returns branch twice. Two execFileSync calls remain canonical; cost is ~1ms each which is acceptable. Will revisit via .git/HEAD parsing only if profiling shows it as a hot path.; Used null sentinel from listLocalBranches() to distinguish 'enumeration failed' from 'legitimately empty branch set' — the prior knownBranchesEmpty heuristic produced false negatives whenever decisions[] was empty, silently dropping the branch_gone signal for blackboard-only audits.
summary: PR A review fixes: replaced knownBranchesEmpty heuristic with explicit null sentinel; added archived to ValueStats lifecycle; regression test for blackboard-only branch_gone audit.
